content:
Duo Admin API is automatically available to paying Duo Premier, Duo Advantage, and
Duo Essentials plan customers and new customers with an Advantage or Premier trial.
Learn how to sign up for a Duo account and receive a free 30-day Duo Advantage trial.
The Admin API lets developers integrate with Duo Security's platform at a low level. The
API has methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting the core objects in
Duo's system: users, phones, hardware tokens, admins, and integrations.
Developers can write applications that programmatically read their Duo account's
authentication logs, administrator logs, and telephony logs; read or update account
settings; and retrieve reports and other information.
Review the API Details to see how to construct your first API request.
Are you a software vendor looking to integrate Duo into your application?
Join our free Duo Technology Partner Program for developer accounts,
joint marketing support, and more!
